table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 68 of 68 rows populated; 67 distinct values.

table:columns.name: YearBuilt
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 62 of 68 rows populated; 27 distinct values.

table:columns.name: DesignatedHeritage
table:columns.description: Whether the site is protected by a heritage designation bylaw under Part 15 of the BC [Local Government Act](https://www.bclaws.gov.bc.ca/civix/document/id/complete/statreg/r15001_16), which restricts alteration and demolition. Distinct from appearing on the heritage register. Measured in this copy: 68 of 68 rows populated; values: 0, 1.

table:columns.name: OnHeritageRegister
table:columns.description: Whether the site appears on the District's heritage register, a list maintained under the same Act. Listing is identification, not legal protection; see DesignatedHeritage for that. Measured in this copy: 68 of 68 rows populated; values: 0, 1.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS object identifier assigned by the source service. Stable within one extract; not a durable key across refreshes.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, in EPSG:26911 (NAD83 / UTM zone 11N) as the District publishes it. Reproject to EPSG:4326 to join against WGS84 data.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box, the GeoParquet 1.1 covering used for spatial predicate pushdown. Derived, not upstream data.
